decision_ledger.rationale: CONTROL stays portable and auditable while exact permissive-source bytes remain recoverable through digest-bound sidecar data.
License and availability determine what may be retained; neither category grants permission to assimilate a mechanism.
Source facts and mechanism hypotheses remain below validated architecture claims until controlled experiments produce evidence.
A catalog-provided Git object id is recomputed from exact bytes before CAS ingestion, preventing self-consistent but upstream-false metadata.
The user requested preservation before further development; no Task 4 completion or post-task review is claimed.
